# Fimforte Specialist Hospital Ltd — Complete Clinical Documentation

## 1. General Entity Overview
Fimforte Specialist Hospital Ltd is an accredited multi-specialty medical facility situated in the Mgbuoba district of Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria. The hospital provides 24-hour round-the-clock inpatient admissions, surgical theatre access, maternal labor suites, and acute trauma management.

### Hospital Key Facts
- Full Legal Name: Fimforte Specialist Hospital Ltd
- Established Location: Number 1 Bloombreed School Road, Opposite NTA, Mgbuoba, Port Harcourt 500272, Rivers State, Nigeria
- Jurisdiction: Nigeria (National Health Insurance Authority / NHIS accredited)
- Operational Schedule: 24 Hours / 7 Days a Week, 365 Days a Year
- Direct 24/7 Telephone Hotline: +234 701 635 7096 / +234 803 931 7663
- WhatsApp Triage Channel: https://wa.me/2347016357096
- Email Address: fimfortehospital@gmail.com
- Official Domain: https://fimfortehospital.ng/

---

## 2. Medical Leadership & Departments

### Leadership
- **Lead Specialist:** Dr. Fimber Chukwuka (Consultant Obstetrician and Gynaecologist)
  - Expertise: Advanced maternal health, high-risk pregnancy deliveries, reproductive surgery, and compassionate fertility management pathways.
- **Consultant Paediatrician:** Dr. Elizabeth Adanwa (Paediatrics & Neonatal Care)
  - Expertise: Neonatal care, acute infant illness, developmental tracking, and childhood preventive healthcare.
- **Chief Consultant General Surgeon:** Dr. Samuel Adebayo
  - Expertise: Elective and emergency surgeries, abdominal trauma, appendectomies, and aseptic operating theatre management.

### Clinical Departments
1. **Obstetrics & Gynaecology (Maternity & Antenatal):**
   - Routine and high-risk antenatal care (ANC)
   - Clean, modern labor and delivery suites
   - Elective and emergency Caesarean sections (C-sections)
   - Management of fibroids, ovarian cysts, and gynaecological emergencies
2. **Fertility & Reproductive Clinic:**
   - Pre-conception counselling and evaluations for couples
   - Ovulation induction and hormone monitoring
   - Ultrasound follicular tracking
3. **Paediatrics & Neonatology:**
   - 24/7 emergency care for newborns, infants, and adolescents
   - National immunization schedule vaccines
   - Phototherapy and neonatal jaundice management
4. **General & Elective Surgery:**
   - Aseptic operating theatres
   - Hernia repair, appendectomy, wound debridement, trauma care
5. **Internal Medicine & Adult Health:**
   - Management of hypertension, type 2 diabetes, stroke recovery, and cardiovascular risks
   - Executive routine full-body health checks
6. **Eye Clinic & Optometry:**
   - Computerized eye examinations, refraction, and prescription eyeglasses
   - Glaucoma and cataract diagnostics
7. **Physiotherapy & Physical Rehabilitation:**
   - Post-operative orthopedic rehabilitation and musculoskeletal pain relief
   - Stroke recovery physical therapy
8. **Diagnostic Laboratory & Immunization:**
   - Automated blood testing, chemistry panels, infectious disease assays
   - Turnaround time under 24 hours

---

## 3. Insurance, HMO Partners & Direct Billing
Fimforte Specialist Hospital Ltd is an accredited provider with direct cashless billing arrangements with major Nigerian Health Maintenance Organizations (HMOs):
- **National & Public Schemes:** NHIS (National Health Insurance Scheme / NHIA)
- **Corporate & Commercial HMOs:** Reliance HMO, Hygeia HMO, IHMS, HCI Healthcare, Hyssop HMO, Leadway Health, Bastion HMO, Anchor HMO, Springtide HMO, Synergy HMO, MB & O Healthcare Services, Oceanic Health, Dot HMO, United Healthcare International, Mediplan Healthcare, NEM Health, Avon HMO, Rivers State Contributory Health Protection Programme (RIVCHPP), Clearline HMO, Health Assur HMO, Alleanza Healthcare, Medical Partners HMO, and specialized Oil & Gas corporate retainerships.
- **Patient Verification:** Direct instant eligibility checking via front-desk intake or through the hospital's digital HMO checker tool.

## 4. Patient Rights & Feedback
Patients are encouraged to submit real verified recovery reviews, photos, or video stories via:
- Online Submission: https://fimfortehospital.ng/submit-testimonial.html
- Moderation & Integrity: Reviews are verified against real clinical encounters before publication.
